parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) A library has 32 800 books. Each year the number of books in the library increases by 300. Calculate the number of years it takes until there are 40 000 books in the library. ................................................. [2]

content.tex: A library has \(32\,800\) books. Each year the number of books in the library increases by 300.
Calculate the number of years it takes until there are \(40\,000\) books in the library.

parts.label: e
parts.text: (e) A different library has 32 695 books at the end of 2024. Each year the number of books increases by 0.6% of the number of books in the library at the end of the previous year.

content.tex: A different library has \(32\,695\) books at the end of 2024. Each year the number of books increases by \(0.6\%\) of the number of books in the library at the end of the previous year.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Calculate the number of books the library had at the end of 2023. ................................................. [2]

content.tex: Calculate the number of books the library had at the end of 2023.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate the number of complete years from 2024 that it takes for the number of books to first be greater than 40 000. ................................................. [4]
